name: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon
label: Quest
description: You Are Rakh'likh, Demon: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Razelikh's lair is atop the highest mountain in the Blasted Lands. The only way to the lair is through the use of the teleport runes near the mountain. As long as you hold the amulet, you can freely transport up to the lair. Once you reach the lair, you must conjure the beast. The amulet is your key, friend. Use it on the Altar of the Defiler.
Should you defeat the Defiler, bring back his horn. It will become a symbol of hope for all that view it - proof that heroes do exist in this war torn world.

clips.title: Progress
paras: There is nothing left to fear.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Today is a day that will be remembered for all eternity. The demonic overlord of the Blasted Lands has finally fallen!
